summary: Tested SvelteKit fantasy basketball UI (Badger Fantasy Association) on localhost:3000. All 9 routes return 200 and render with no JS errors. Home (hero + Rando Player + Shuffle + matchup cards), Rosters (14 cards + collapse), Standings (regular + playoff tables, season selector reloads data correctly), Matchups (rows + season/week selectors update URL & data), Records-team (H2H selector), Admin tool, sticky header, mobile menu — all work. Found a critical reproducible bug on Honor Hall and Records-Player pages: the season dropdown updates the URL query string but the page DATA does not refresh (SSR load not re-triggered). Direct URL navigation works correctly, confirming server load is fine — bug is purely client-side form/navigation wiring.

integration_issues.issue: Changing [data-testid='honor-season-select'] updates URL to ?season=XXXX but the displayed data (Champion, Biggest Loser, MVPs, Final Standings, page heading 'SEASON YYYY') is NOT refreshed. A full page reload (or direct URL nav) renders correct data. Reproducer: Open /honor-hall (default 2025 → Champion 'The Emperors'). Change selector to 2022. URL becomes /honor-hall?season=2022 but Champion stays 'The Emperors'. Direct nav to /honor-hall?season=2022 correctly shows 'Team Lobster' as champion.

Same root cause as Honor Hall. Changing [data-testid='player-season-select'] (form id='filters' method='get') sets the URL to ?season=XXXX but the SSR data (MVP cards heading 'Season MVPs · YYYY', Overall/Finals MVP) does not refresh. Tested both pure change event and explicit form.requestSubmit() — neither triggers a load. Direct URL navigation (?season=2022) correctly renders 2022 MVPs (Giannis / Dejounte Murray) confirming +page.server.js load works.

action_items: Fix client-side navigation on Honor Hall (+page.svelte) and Records-Player (+page.svelte) season selector forms so that submitting/changing the dropdown causes SvelteKit to re-run the load function. Options: (a) add `data-sveltekit-reload` to the <form>, (b) use `use:enhance` with explicit invalidateAll() in the result handler, or (c) on:change handler that calls `goto(\`?season=\${value}\`, { invalidateAll: true })`. Standings and Matchups pages already do this correctly — mirror that implementation.
Verify whether season heading text on Honor Hall ('SEASON YYYY') uses the same reactive source as the dropdown — the heading and selector were briefly out of sync during testing.
critical_code_review_comments: Honor Hall + Records-Player rely on plain HTML GET form submission; SvelteKit intercepts the resulting navigation but does not re-run +page.server.js load. Other pages (Matchups, Standings) use a pattern that works — align all season/week selectors to the same pattern.
Sleeper API is called server-side on every request — consider caching for performance/rate-limiting (not blocking, just a recommendation).

success_rate.frontend: ~85% — 11/13 tested flows pass; 2 season-selector flows broken on Honor Hall + Records-Player

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two pages share an identical bug pattern: Honor Hall and Records-Player. URL query updates on dropdown change but content does not. After main agent fixes, retest by: 1) Loading /honor-hall, changing dropdown to 2022, verify Champion changes to 'Team Lobster' (Seed #3). 2) Loading /records-player, changing dropdown to 2022, verify Overall MVP changes to 'Giannis Antetokounmpo' and Finals MVP to 'Dejounte Murray'. All other flows (Home rando shuffle, Rosters collapse, Standings season change, Matchups season+week change, Records-team H2H change, Mobile menu, Admin page, sticky header) work correctly and do not need retesting unless modified.
rca of the issue: Both Honor Hall and Records-Player implement their season selector as a plain HTML <form method='get'> with a select that submits the form on change. SvelteKit's client-side router intercepts the submission and updates the URL via pushState/replaceState, but because the form is not enhanced (no use:enhance) and lacks `data-sveltekit-reload`, the +page.server.js load function is not re-invoked. The server-side load WORKS correctly when the URL is visited directly (verified by direct navigation to ?season=2022 returning correct, season-specific data). Fix: either add data-sveltekit-reload to the <form>, or use SvelteKit's $app/navigation goto() with { invalidateAll: true } in an on:change handler. The Matchups page already uses a correct pattern — replicate it.
